svg.text: TIS and policy/rollout mismatch · 16K Math RL · Train:Rollout = 1:7
thin = per-step, bold = trailing-5 · vertical colored dashes = sustained reward < 0.30
TIS = clamp(pi_train / pi_rollout, 0, 2); clip fraction counts only ratios above 2.
Zero-loss TIS metrics exclude initially masked truncated tokens; sequence ESS is omitted because full-response length confounds it.
